guidetextdraw._value: INSTRUCTIONS: Provide the following information regarding the value and debt or your parent’s assets. Indicate zero, if not applicable. See definition of parent below. Incomplete documents will not be returned. They will be disposed of in a secure manner, per university policy. This will delay processing.
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1668091907488

guidetextdraw_2132317172._value:
Definition of parent: For the FAFSA, “parent” refers to your biological and/ or adoptive parents (including your step-parent If that person is currently married to your “parent”).
The following are NOT considered to be a “legal parent” for the FAFSA:

  • Grandparents, foster parents, legal guardians, aunts and uncles are NOT considered parents unless they have legally adopted you.
  • Any person who is not married to your parent and who is not a legal or biological parent

If your parent’s FAFSA marital status is “married,” or “unmarried and both parents living together,” then both their information must be provided.
guidetextdraw_2132317172.name: textdraw_21323171721670394676739

guidetextdraw_679423705._value:
Do not include:

  • a home, if it is the principal residence;
  • a farm, if it is the principal residence and your parent(s) participated in the farm's operation;
  • personal or consumer loans, or any debts that are not related to the assets listed below;
  • the value of retirement plans (pension funds, IRA's, Keogh Plans, etc.); or
  • student financial aid.
guidetextdraw_679423705.name: textdraw_6794237051670394855790

guidetextdraw_1210647729._value: Assets Value and Debt are to be reported as of the date the 2022-2023 Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) was filed.
